Small bowel obstruction is less likely without prior surgery, hernias, or constipation/vomiting, but acute mechanical obstruction (e.g., from adhesions or internal hernia) can rarely present abruptly during exertion. Splenic rupture is plausible due to contact sport (football) and left upper quadrant pain referral, but typical presentation includes left shoulder pain (Kehr sign), hypotension, or guarding—none reported yet; thus confidence is lower pending exam/imaging."}
